intro: Honduras is a presidential republic with a single-chamber congress.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years. Xiomara Castro was the first woman president from 2022. The November 2025 election was very close and disputed, and Nasry Asfura was declared the winner.

chapters.title: Security
text: Gang violence has been a major problem.
